views.local: Rigid root transformation fixes lower_arm at [0,0,.35], identity orientation; upstream links hidden; same camera, elevation -90

assessment.strongest_supported_result: Saved encoder wrist-flex delta is +14.241758 degrees. In this model, wrist-to-forearm rotation is +14.241758 for positive sign and -14.241758 for negative sign, independently of upstream changes and jaw display policy. These signed FK values are conditional predictions, not a measured physical angle.

qualitative_photo_review.A_positive_zero: Plausible folded-arm baseline: distal gripper projects away and below the wrist in side-view model render, broadly resembling supplied side photos. Not a fitted match or a verified mapping.
qualitative_photo_review.B_negative_zero: Gripper projects predominantly upward under shared upstream/root assumptions; qualitatively less consistent with the downward-projecting distal assembly in supplied side photos. Conditional mismatch, not independently ruled out.
qualitative_photo_review.C_positive_minus90: Also predominantly upward in model side view under shared assumptions; qualitatively less consistent. This illustrative offset is not fitted.
qualitative_photo_review.D_negative_plus90: Distal assembly remains nearer horizontal in shared model side view; cannot select or reject rigorously from these differing perspectives.

ruled_out_claims: Only the wrist observation changed (elbow and pan also changed).
Every tested mapping satisfies all model limits (shoulder conflict in all eight states).
World gripper orientation change equals wrist-flex change (counterexamples 23.437351 versus 5.338650 degrees).
Relative endpoint change identifies wrist zero offset (constant offsets cancel).
assessment.not_ruled_out: Neither physical sign nor a unique zero offset is conclusively excluded or verified by this uncalibrated photo comparison. No candidate adopted.
remaining_ambiguity: Other four arm signs and zeros remain assumed positive/zero; this is wrist sensitivity analysis, not a global mapping search.
Views are not fitted to camera intrinsics/extrinsics; front framing differs and side photos look from opposite sides.
New-photo mirroring and camera identity remain unknown; prior take confirmations do not apply automatically.
Gripper normalized-value conversion is unverified; affine model-range display is arbitrary.
Shoulder-lift zero/range conflict, root/table alignment and omitted camera/servos remain unresolved.
